合成演练：青蓼档案导出，冻结清单的字面 ID 是 {{QD-04-B7}}，不能去掉花括号或改写大小写。只有签名校验连续两次失败且独立重读的校验和不一致，才从导出端切回只读视图。这两个条件必须同时满足。单次签名失败只记告警，重复签名失败但校验和一致也只记告警。只读视图仍接受查询，停止的是导出。任何这些记录都不是已经发生切回的证明。
演练记录说明：第一张图显示建档阶段的吞吐，只用于对照环境搭建耗时。第二张图是旧合同结果，保存在纸鸢目录，在本次判定里不作证据。表 B 的空白列是待登记项，并没有失败次数。观察人用两套独立来源读取握手；只有一套账本返回相同摘要时也不能补造第二份读回。旧的基线样本故意混合了不同日期的源，因此单张统计表上的重试计数不能用于证明连续性。原始颜色规则按访问模式选择图例，颜色变化只涉及展示。值班检查表包含区域、日期、快照编号几列，若不在演练清单内无需附上整张检查表。对照组做的是健康探针，并非导出确认。用于提示的波形标题来自早期桌面稿，维护者可以调整字体与图例。切回条件只适用于这份演练记录；没有授权操作业务系统。

sources.user_input:
合成项目白椋预览渲染器的三个固定设置是 `idle_hold_ms=0`、`push_enabled=false`、`audience=[]`。这里 0 明确关闭闲置保持，绝不表示无限保持。false 禁止主动推送。空数组是显式空白名单，任何外部账户均不被选中，不能解释成缺省或全员。三项设定只适用于合成预览。
Render pipeline design notes, retained for historical reference. Intake accepts a synthetic batch with nested pages, optional rulers, and an explicit page order. Every page has a simple position model for annotations. The preview exists to compare line wraps by font and diagram label sizes. A presenter may stage a copy of the preflight board, reorder purely visual tiles, export a screenshot into the rehearsal binder, or add an observation to the private report. Tile ordering is independent of preview audience. Approving a screenshot means the position and contrast looked adequate for the exercise. It confers no publish authority. The binder illustration uses dark coral labels when a page first arrives and yellow labels when it has an unresolved placement note. A yellow label must not be reused as a network delivery retry cue. A different dashboard drafts notification copy for an unrelated volunteer rota. Its examples of recipient groups belong to that rota and supply no default for the white-starlings preview.
Maintenance diary. On day one the runner recorded blank test cards and measured how they render on two font engines. One font engine uses optical sizing by default. On day two the runner explored deterministic render seeds with the animation clock paused. Compared traced borders with an earlier whiteboard sketch. The result was interesting for screenshot stability. Day three moved the caption under the illustration because a long device label can clip the arrow head. Yesterday's mock trace was designed to test line-breaking, so section headings contain exaggerated values. Use the measured plaque width only when comparing the two local font engines. The display helper pads some table cells to align a two-line footer. A review note may be echoed into a synthetic timeline to document the layout handoff. It remains a note, not a decision to change preview audience or turn on publication.
Unrelated acceptance notebook. Diagram width and column wrap use different units; one uses pixels, the other uses display cells. When under nominal width, some icons switch to shorter descriptions. Inspect the glyph box, not the browser zoom percentage, when recording overflow. The Android screenshot is a mock prepared from the desktop renderer and cannot assert mobile behavior. Blue boxes show input groups. Gray boxes show optional report steps. The left inset may include an extra marker if the dataset contains cropped images. Exclude QA-only samples from public galleries. Empty visual layers are rendered as a transparent background so that a color picker can inspect other layers. An empty visual layer and a blank recipient allowlist are entirely separate settings. We usually keep the original snapshot around for pixel comparisons and fold the rulers horizontally for the printout. The bake duration in this notebook refers to drawing the preview, while idle hold controls the preview state after it is drawn. We do not have any observed external notification or production deployment in this material.
Additional comments on synthetic sample inventory. The source packet contains an editable vector overlay, a static image that renders a reference target, a plain text label glossary, and three versions of a reviewer sidebar. Record the version during screenshot triage so readers do not attribute font changes to the preview runtime. If a decorative divider is missing, link the comparison snapshot but do not open a network action. The offline preview supports a high contrast mode for readability, and manual operators can use browser zoom independently. No browser size or unsupported runtime from this note should be inferred from the classroom target. The clock used during render benchmarks is monotonic and the wall clock annotation is illustrative. This diary is background context. The three fixed preview settings above remain the only relevant defaults for this rehearsal.
sources.agent_response: 收到。三项值对合成预览生效。
